title: Uniform local mass bounds give uniform sup-norm bounds for T_j(ω) on test forms supported in a fixed compact set
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let T_j ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n, j ∈ ℕ) satisfy ⨆_j M_W(T_j) < ∞ in [0, ∞] (M_W = massOn, Simon 6.2.5 with the Euclidean coefficient norm) for every bounded open W ⊆ ℝ^P. Then for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P there is a real c ≥ 0 such that |T_j(ω)| ≤ c·s for every j ∈ ℕ, every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) (TestFormOn univ n) with tsupport ω ⊆ K and every s ∈ ℝ with ‖ω(x)‖ ≤ s for all x ∈ ℝ^P, where ‖·‖ is the operator norm on Covector (Euclid P) n.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Ts : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → Bornology.IsBounded W → ⨆ j, (Ts j).massOn W < ∞) → ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ (j : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (s : ℝ), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ K → (∀ x, ‖(ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x‖ ≤ s) → |Ts j ω| ≤ c * s
